summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Legend Biotech Corporation, a foreign private issuer. The filing furnishes a press release and investor presentation announcing first clinical proof-of-concept data for LB2501, an in vivo CAR-T cell therapy, presented at a medical congress. It does not involve any corporate transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other special situation. The content is purely a clinical update with no financial or structural terms. Accordingly, this filing does not meet the criteria for a special-situations category.
